## Public Summary

Bazhena Dementyeva (also known as Maria Dementyeva, Maria Demy and bashdemy) is a Sydney-based senior software engineer with full-stack experience across product teams, startups and production systems. Her work spans digital healthcare, workflow automation and client websites. She brings experience in taking product problems from discovery to shipped implementation, backend and API development, web and mobile delivery, cloud infrastructure and CI/CD.

## Selected Experience

- Eucalyptus: engineering on digital healthcare products across web, backend and mobile systems, supporting patient and clinician experiences. Listed technologies include TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL, React Native, PostgreSQL, Go, microservices and GCP.
- Workflow86: workflow automation platform for business operations.
- Sonia Kania Photography: designed and built a photography portfolio and booking website with Next.js and TypeScript.
- UNSW: Master of Information Technology specialising in Artificial Intelligence, listed as in progress; do not describe this degree as completed.
